profile.headline: Software Engineer at Splash (SplashThat.com)
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with experience in web development and multi-platform desktop applications, with a background in electronics, robotics, and artificial intelligence.

When I first discovered programming, I was excited that I could be totally creative and build applications to help people use resources I had at my disposal in my own home! From that moment on, I knew I wanted to become a programmer.

I believe that one of my best qualities is that I like to discuss in order to find the best approach to any problem (mainly in software architecture). 

I am very passionate about software development and love talking about it with other fellow software engineers. Please feel free to contact me if you share my passions or have an interesting article to share!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Splash is an event marketing tool that helps companies launch events by managing pre-event tasks such as guest management, branded email campaigns, and customizable web pages; during-event tasks such as check-in, check-out, and guest real-time communication; and post-event tasks such as guest assistance reports and predictions for future events.

In the development team, we follow agile methodologies and use professional services, including Jira, git, CodeShip, AWS, and docker. We also focus on our code quality having strict code reviews, end2end and unit testing, linters, etc. 

At Splash, I worked on projects, such as:
- Leading the back-end design and implementation of a generic Guest App which is able to handle real-time chatting with over 10,000 concurrent clients and over 50,000 messages per hour
- Implementing an email deliverability system capable of sending over 2 million customizable emails a month and providing detailed campaign analytics
- Contributing to the development of the Open Splash REST API with the Symfony framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At BQ, in our educational department, we create an amazing application to help kids start in the robotics world. Here you can interactively crate your circuits and code in an intuitive way with blocks. Check it out! (http://bitbloq.bq.com)

At Bitbloq, I was the leader of the Web2Board project, a multi-platform application that manages all the communication between the web-app and the microcontroller platform. As a leader, I listened to client suggestions, provided technical support on site, created user stories, and designed and defined the software architecture. 

This project it Open Source! (https://github.com/bq/web2board) Use, modify, or contribute to it as you please.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
EasyVista is a global leader in consumerized service management. We help IT departments become Chief Service Providers. With EV Service AppStore, lines of business are now building their own applications without any coding.

As a Software developer at EasyVista, I collaborated on the development of EV Service AppStore and created a stable and scalable API, which can manage hundreds of applications per client.  I was also deeply involved in improving the applications' analytics, gathering useful information such as most-used widgets by the designers or how the final user used the applications. The analytics tool also provided real-time or date-range accumulative reports in a web-based monitor app.

positions.title: Surveillance Solutions and Development Engineer
positions.description:
Vestas is a global leader in the development, manufacturing, sale, and maintenance of wind power plants. The Surveillance Department monitors over ten thousand turbines worldwide 24/7 to ensure that everything is working in the most effective way and that no main components are damaged.

As a Surveillance Solutions Engineer, I designed and implemented tools to improve the performance of the department and to offer new services to internal and external clients. Some of the tools I implemented were:

 - RQSL (Really Quick Service Line): An application that manages alarms received by the turbines which shows real-time information about the wind-farm and the affected turbine. This tool was able to reduce the main KPI (time/alarm) of the department by 50%. 
- Grid Work Planner: A tool that schedules remote actions needed for specific grid works.
- Custom monitoring: A flexible background task that allows the department to monitor specific conditions per wind-farm and turbine, providing a more personal service.
